/** Supplement to frozen R45/R66: real previous Communications/Tasks and ACL catalog. */
import {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {randomUUID as uid} from 'node:crypto';
import {isolatedBooking,bookingMigration,write} from '../../support/h2-booking-isolated.ts';
import {bookingFixture} from '../../support/h2-booking-fixtures.ts';
const h=await isolatedBooking('crm_h2010_mig',55486,true);
async function capture(){return {
 data:await h.observer`select jsonb_object_agg(k,v) d from (select 'Communication' k,jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by record_id) v from crm_private.b07_records x union all select 'Tasks',jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by task_id) from crm_private.b07_pending_tasks x union all select 'IdentityCodes',jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by code_id) from crm_private.identity_codes x union all select 'Acceptance',jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by acceptance_id) from crm_private.b03_acceptances x union all select 'Version',jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) order by version_id) from crm_private.b03_proposal_versions x) q`,
 tables:await h.observer`select c.oid,c.relname,c.relacl::text,c.relowner::regrole::text,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='crm_private' and c.relkind='r' and c.relname not like 'b04_%' order by c.oid`,
 functions:await h.observer`select p.oid,p.proacl::text,md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) hash from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname in ('crm_api','crm_f1','crm_f2','crm_private') and p.proname not like 'booking_%' order by p.oid`,
 policies:await h.observer`select p.oid,c.relname,p.polname,p.polroles::text,pg_get_expr(p.polqual,p.polrelid) q,pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck,p.polrelid) w from pg_policy p join pg_class c on c.oid=p.polrelid where c.relname not like 'b04_%' order by p.oid`,
 triggers:await h.observer`select t.oid,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) d from pg_trigger t join pg_class c on c.oid=t.tgrelid where c.relnamespace='crm_private'::regnamespace and c.relname not like 'b04_%' order by t.oid`,
 roles:await h.observer`select rolname,rolsuper,rolbypassrls,rolcreaterole,rolcreatedb from pg_roles order by rolname`
};}
try{const b=await bookingFixture(h),c=h.req('communication',{direction:'incoming',channel:'email',sender_ref:b.f.accepterId,coverage:b.q.coverage,initial_fact:'received',proposal_version_ref:b.q.versionId},b.q.opportunityId);await h.evidence.apply(await h.auth(),write,{...c,occurredAt:new Date().toISOString(),coverage:b.q.coverage});
 await h.tasks.apply(await h.auth(),write,{action:'receive',operationId:uid(),taskId:uid(),expectedRevision:0,identity:{causeKind:'review',causeId:uid(),contextKind:'opportunity',contextId:b.q.opportunityId,scopeRef:b.q.coverage,relatedKind:null,relatedId:null,effect:'review-only'},material:{title:'SYNTHETIC previous followup',deadline:{kind:'unknown',reason:'no actual deadline'},priority:{kind:'pending',reason:'no actual priority'},sourceRef:'synthetic',sourceVersion:'v1',triggerRef:'manual',triggerVersion:'SM-TA-01-v1'},reason:'SYNTHETIC prior Task'});
 const old=await capture();await h.migration.unsafe(await readFile(new URL(`../../../supabase/migrations/${bookingMigration}`,import.meta.url),'utf8'));const current=await capture();const oldTriggerIds=new Set(old.triggers.map(x=>x.oid));const additions=current.triggers.filter(x=>!oldTriggerIds.has(x.oid));assert.ok(additions.every(x=>x.d.includes('FROM crm_private.b04_')&&x.d.includes('RI_FKey_noaction')));assert.equal(additions.length,36);assert.deepEqual({...current,triggers:Array.from(current.triggers).filter(x=>oldTriggerIds.has(x.oid))},{...old,triggers:Array.from(old.triggers)});
 assert.equal((await h.observer`select count(*)::int n from crm_private.b07_pending_tasks`)[0]!.n,1);assert.ok((await h.observer`select count(*)::int n from crm_private.b07_records where record_kind='communication'`)[0]!.n>0);
 await h.booking.apply(await h.auth(),write,b.q);const baseline=(await h.observer`select chain_snapshot from crm_private.b04_bookings where booking_id=${b.q.bookingId}::uuid`)[0]!.chain_snapshot;const ref=b.detail.services[0]!.serviceRevisionId,item=(await h.observer`select item_id from crm_private.catalog_revisions where revision_id=${ref}::uuid`)[0]!.item_id;
 await h.catalog.apply(await h.auth(),write,{action:'publish_version',operationId:uid(),targetId:item,kind:'service',expectedVersion:1,sourceRef:'SYNTHETIC actual later master revision',evidenceRef:'SYNTHETIC',reason:'SYNTHETIC changed current classification',definition:{name:'SYNTHETIC changed current master',nature:'internal'}});
 assert.deepEqual((await h.observer`select chain_snapshot from crm_private.b04_bookings where booking_id=${b.q.bookingId}::uuid`)[0]!.chain_snapshot,baseline);assert.ok((await h.observer`select nature from crm_private.b04_services where booking_id=${b.q.bookingId}::uuid`).every(x=>x.nature==='external'));assert.equal((await h.observer`select count(*)::int n from crm_private.catalog_revisions where item_id=${item}::uuid`)[0]!.n,2);
 console.log('R57 actual same master new revision/classification retains old applied Booking snapshot: PASS');
 console.log('R45/R66 V-MIG predecessor IDs/data/snapshots/Communications/Tasks/codes/ACL/owners/RLS/functions/policies/triggers/roles: PASS');console.log(JSON.stringify({previousTables:old.tables.length,previousFunctions:old.functions.length,previousPolicies:old.policies.length,previousTriggers:old.triggers.length}));
}finally{await h.close();}
